description:
Title: Service for Your Fridge

Your fridge produces strange noises.
You describe the symptoms, and send them together with the type of fridge to the central fridge service center.
They select a local service facility (which all have their own way of interacting with customers).
The service facility makes an appointment.
They arrive at a random time, and sometimes have to leave without repairing your fridge, because they need additional parts.
After your fridge is repaired, you have to confirm that it is OK again.
You can rate the service facility.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/service-for-your-fridge">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceRequest" name="Symptoms and fridge type"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceReferral" name="Service referral"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Appointment" name="Appointment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Confirmation that the fridge is OK"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ServiceForFridge">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CentralCenter" name="Central fridge service center" processRef="Process_CentralCenter"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ServiceFacility" name="Local service facility" processRef="Process_ServiceFacility"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceRequest" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceRequest" targetRef="Start_CenterReceivesRequest" messageRef="Message_ServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceReferral" sourceRef="Task_SendReferral" targetRef="Start_FacilityReceivesReferral" messageRef="Message_ServiceReferral"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Appointment" sourceRef="Task_MakeAppointment" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAppointment" messageRef="Message_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmFridgeOK" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer service request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_FridgeNoises" name="Fridge produces strange noises"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DescribeSymptoms" name="Describe symptoms and fridge type"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendServiceRequest" name="Send service request" messageRef="Message_ServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAppointment" name="Receive appointment" messageRef="Message_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitForArrival" name="Wait for service facility to arrive"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerRepairOutcome" name="Fridge repaired?" default="Flow_Customer_Repaired"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NoRepair" name="Fridge not repaired because additional parts are needed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerNoRepair" name="Fridge not repaired"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FridgeRepaired" name="Fridge repaired"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ConfirmFridgeOK" name="Confirm fridge is OK again" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RateFacility" name="Rate the service facility?" default="Flow_Customer_NoRating"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateFacility" name="Rate the service facility"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerService" name="Customer service complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_FridgeNoises" targetRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms" targetRef="Task_SendServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAppointment" targetRef="Event_WaitForArrival"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Event_WaitForArrival" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerRepairOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_NotRepaired" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerRepairOutcome" targetRef="Task_NoRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">additionalPartsNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_NoRepairEnd" sourceRef="Task_NoRepair" targetRef="End_CustomerNoRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Repaired" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerRepairOutcome" targetRef="Event_FridgeRepaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Event_FridgeRepaired" targetRef="Task_ConfirmFridgeOK"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmFridgeOK" targetRef="Gateway_RateFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Rate" sourceRef="Gateway_RateFacility" targetRef="Task_RateFacility">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">chooseToRate</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_NoRating" sourceRef="Gateway_RateFacility" targetRef="End_CustomerService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_RatingToEnd" sourceRef="Task_RateFacility" targetRef="End_CustomerService"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CentralCenter" name="Central fridge service center" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CenterReceivesRequest" name="Service request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CenterRequest" messageRef="Message_ServiceRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFacility" name="Select local service facility"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReferral" name="Send service referral" messageRef="Message_ServiceReferral"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CenterReferralSent" name="Local facility selected"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Center_1" sourceRef="Start_CenterReceivesRequest" targetRef="Task_SelectFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Center_2" sourceRef="Task_SelectFacility" targetRef="Task_SendReferral"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Center_3" sourceRef="Task_SendReferral" targetRef="End_CenterReferralSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ServiceFacility" name="Local service facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_FacilityReceivesReferral" name="Service referral received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FacilityReferral" messageRef="Message_ServiceReferral"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_MakeAppointment" name="Make appointment" messageRef="Message_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Arrive" name="Arrive at a random time"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalParts" name="Additional parts needed?" default="Flow_PartsNotNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" name="Leave without repairing the fridge"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_WithoutRepair" name="Service left without repair"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairFridge" name="Repair the fridge"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive customer confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairService" name="Repair service complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_1" sourceRef="Start_FacilityReceivesReferral" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_2" sourceRef="Task_MakeAppointment" targetRef="Task_Arrive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_3" sourceRef="Task_Arrive" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsNeeded" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalParts" targetRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">additionalPartsNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsNotNeeded" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalParts" targetRef="Task_RepairFridge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_4" sourceRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" targetRef="End_WithoutRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_5" sourceRef="Task_RepairFridge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="End_RepairService"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
